testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and dismisses the file display menu ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And files are displayed in Details view ✔ And a part name and preview are displayed ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected in Details view ✔ When the user opens the file display menu ✔ Then the menu offers extra large, large, medium and small icon sizes ✔ And it offers List, Details, Tiles and Content views ✔ And Details is indicated as the current view ✔ When the user dismisses the menu without choosing another view ✔ Then the file list remains in Details view ✔ And the part name and preview remain displayed
